purpose: Music for Missions 1–3 and the optional Bonus. Efe Inan supplied Mission 2 and both Mission 3 battle themes.
playback: Battle music loops from the three-second countdown at master volume 0.18 with 0.35-second fades. Mission 3 fades its first theme when the first health pool is spent. The phase-two theme begins with the second countdown on both the normal transition and direct retry.
import: Stereo preserved; Streaming; Vorbis quality 0.8; original sample rate; preload metadata/audio enabled; load in background enabled. No platform override.

loudness_matching.method: FFmpeg EBU R128 integrated LUFS scan on the original stereo recordings, with constant playback gain. Arrays are in mission order: Mission 1, Mission 2, Mission 3 phase one, Bonus. Prior measurements for the three existing tracks are unchanged.
loudness_matching.note: Source bytes and internal dynamics are unchanged. Unity codec/device effects and subjective perception are not measured by the source-file scanner. The .18 music master follows the per-wave gain.
